verdict.rationale: Edge0 runs 4-bit quantized base models, using distilled LoRA adapters to recover quantization loss (edge0-gh-3). However, loading appears limited to its own bundled tier checkpoints, which are auto-detected from config.json (edge0-gh-4, edge0-gh-9), with no evidence of loading arbitrary third-party quantized formats. Missing for 10: documented support for FP8, INT4 checkpoint formats, GPTQ and AWQ; loading of non-Edge0 quantized checkpoints; a list of supported formats; independent corroboration.
